greeting.text: I... yes. What do you need?

before_farewell.text: Give me a moment. I would like to... say goodbye. Speak to her, if you would, first. She would have liked that.

after_farewell.text: He is gone, your friend. I do not blame him. I would go too, if I did not have a kingdom with its roof off. But my father is alive, and my people are alive, and there is a man named Varkos who is not.

choices.text: Come with me, Lucan. We will find him together.
Stay with your people. They need you.

joins.text: Then I am yours, for as long as it takes. I have my harp, and I have nothing left to lose but the habit of being afraid. Speak to my father first; he knows more of the pearl you are after than anyone alive.

stays.text: My people have a king, for now. They need a prince who can fight more than they need one who can stand. Ask me again when you are ready.

with_you.text: I am with you. Say the word, and I will sing the room to sleep.
